Commentary.Commentary: So, we finally have our two teams who will participate in the World Cup next year. Afghanistan will join Windies on the biggest stage of them all. Even though the Afghans were the better team today, Ireland did exceptionally well to take the game deep and make it such a close contest. They put in some good performances throughout the tournament and can keep their heads held high. Anyway, before these two teams can celebrate their entries into the World Cup, they have a final to play. Join in on 25th March, at 0930 local (0730 GMT) as Windies and Afghanistan battle it out for victory. See you folks then!

William Porterfield, Ireland captain, starts by congratulating the Afghanistan team. Adds that they were a few runs short today. Feels that they did have a chance today, but it wasn't meant to be. States that they did learn a lot from this tournament as they will look forward to the upcoming Test series.

Asghar Stanikzai, Afghanistan captain, says that he was in pain but the country comes first for him. Reckons it's a dream day for his side and adds that they made a good comeback and believed in themselves as they were hungry to win this encounter.

Mohammad Shahzad, Man of the Match, thanks the Almighty and adds they have played good cricket to win this match. Reckons he waited to convert the loose deliveries and also says that he believes himself and the staff backs him to play his natural game. Ends by saying that he is happy to play the final with Windies and issues a warning that they are coming for them.

Heartbreak for Ireland though. They played their hearts out and had they won, would have been equally deserving of going through to the big stage. Earlier in the day, Ireland were restricted to 209 courtesy some excellent bowling from the Afghans. The charge was led by Rashid Khan with 3 wickets and he was supported well by the others. The O'Brien brothers did their part, with the younger providing a late impetus towards the end. One wonders, had the others did just a little more, then even 15-20 runs could have made all the difference.

Superb game! Went down till the last over. With a meek target of 210 to gun down, Afghanistan got off to good start with Mohammad Shahzad firing away with a brisk fifty, and he had good support in Gulbadin Naib. But, after Shahzad's dismissal, Ireland pulled things back with some disciplined bowling. Plugged the scoring rate, kept taking wickets at regular intervals and it seemed they would get the better of their opponents. But, a returning Asghar Stanikzai came in and took control of things. He relieved the pressure with some vital hits at the right moments and along with Najibullah Zadran, who did his part, took Afghanistan home and into their first ever World Cup.

AFGHANISTAN WIN BY 5 WICKETS! Asghar Stanikzai hits the winning runs. He pumps his fist in the air because he knows his team is going to the 2019 World Cup. Coach Phil Simmons is hugging his players. The rest of the team screams in joy. Jubilant scenes. Yorker on leg, Stanikzai somehow manages to dig it out off the inside edge down to fine leg for a boundary.
Barry McCarthy to bowl the final over of the game.
Moves across to this bumper and pulls it over backward square leg. One run taken. Afghanistan just need 1 run to win this game. The scores a level now.
Taps this in front of point. The skipper wants the single but his partner sends him back.
On a good length and outside off, Asghar runs this down to third man. The fielder in the deep cuts it off and the batsmen take two. Just two more needed to win now.
Short ball wide outside off, Stanikzai looks to cut but misses. Niall behind the stumps is the only one to appeal, but the umpire denies it.
Short ball on off, the left-hander backs away and slaps it well over point. The fielder from the deep comes running in and takes it on the bounce. Single taken.

Length ball down the leg side, Najibullah just helps it fine down the leg side. Andy Balbirnie does well to run to his left and slide to keep it in play. Keeps the batsmen to two, but these runs are vital for Afghanistan nonetheless.
Slower short ball on middle, Najibullah goes for the big swing across the line again, but gets an inside edge onto his thigh pad. Single taken as the ball goes to the leg side.

SIX! HE HAS MIDDLED THAT! Najibullah Zadran showing all this effort in the gym. All his muscles put into work here. Length ball around off, he clears his front leg and blasts this right off the meat. Clears long on and sends it sailing deep into the stands. What a hit! 8 needed off 13 now.
Takes the pace off this one, on middle, whipped to short mid-wicket.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, Najibullah swings and off the inner half plays it through backward square leg for a brace.
Fraction straight in line, on middle stump, Zadran with a tap to mid-wicket, straight to the fielder.
Fraction straight in line, on middle stump, Zadran with a tap to mid-wicket, straight to the fielder.
Slanting across on a good length, around off, it's run down to third man for one run.
Played to point for no run.

Excellent running between the wickets. Shortish ball on leg, Najibullah works it through backward square leg. Stanikzai is the one who calls for the second and his partner responds. Both batsmen complete the run with ease.
Length ball around the off stump, pushes at it tamely from inside the crease.
Shortish delivery pounded on off, Najibullah awkwardly fends it away on the off side.
Short and wide outside off, punched solidly through to deep point for a single.
Boyd Rankin comes back into the attack.
Length delivery, nudged to square leg for a run. 20 required from 24. The team batting should be through. But cricket is a funny game, don't expect the obvious.
Slower delivery, full down the leg side. Stanikzai works it to fine leg and calls his partner for a quick couple.
Back of a length delivery, defended back to the bowler.
FOUR! Much needed one for Afghanistan. Short delivery, Stanikzai guides past the right of the keeper to the third man fence for a boundary.
Short delivery banged in outside off stump, the batsman lets it be. That's one bounce for the over.
Back of a length delivery outside the off stump channel, pushed to sweeper cover for a single.
Tim Murtagh to have a go with the ball.
Back of a length well outside off, Najibullah is off the mark with a slap to sweeper cover. Single taken.
Najibullah Zadran will be the next man in.

OUT! Ireland with an important breakthrough at a crucial juncture. Full and outside off, Shenwari slices it straight to Gary Wilson at point, who gets low and takes a sharp catch. 29 needed in 31 balls. Shenwari departs after a rather slow-paced knock.
Wide! Down the leg side, looks to flick but misses.
Coming back in on middle and leg, Stanikzai walks down the track and flicks it off his pads towards square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, Asghar lofts it over covers and comes back for the second.

SIX! 10 in 2 balls. This is the over he decides to cut loose. Fuller in length on off, Stanikzai launches this high over mid on. George Dockrell (sub) who is at the rope, leans and stretches his hands out. Just about misses as the ball goes over him. Maximum!
FOUR! That should relieve some pressure. Short of a length on off, Stanikzai picks up the length early and rocks back. Pulls it over mid-wicket and gets a boundary.
Barry McCarthy to bowl once more.
Dot ball to end the over. 43 needed off 36. It's played back to the bowler from within the crease.
Kneels down to the fuller ball and sweeps it through backward square leg for a double.
Dabbed to mid-wicket. No run taken.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Flatter and short on the stumps, pulled down towards fine leg for a run.
Spinning into the batsman, on middle and leg, worked away with a firm punch towards mid-wicket.
Andy McBrine is back.
Leans ahead to the full ball and knocks it to long on for a single.
Short of a good length around off, kept out off the back foot.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Good length ball on middle stump, moves inside the line and works it to mid-wicket.
Yorker on leg, tailing down further. Stanikzai is lucky he gets some bat on this before the ball hits his boot and goes on the off side. Single taken.
Short and wide outside off, placed with an angled bat to point.
Boyd Rankin comes back into the attack.
Straighter one on middle, gets inside the line and tucks it to square leg.
Tossed right up there, wristed to the long on area to get off strike.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Landed short and flat around off, hit down to long on for a single.
Whipped with some decent power to the right of the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Turning in on off stump, worked gently to the right of the bowler.
Bit of width offered outside off, Shenwari drives it hard to sweeper cover for one.
Straightening up after hitting the deck, Samiullah dabs it with an open face to point.
Just ahead of a length on off stump, moves inside the line and works it to the right of the bowler.
Steers this good length delivery outside off to the left of third man and takes a single.
Full delivery angling in on off, blocked on the leg side.
FOUR! Streaky runs, but Afghanistan won't mind as long as they come. Length ball wide outside off, Stanikzai reaches out to it and gets a thick edge down to third man for a boundary.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the game.
Flatter and shorter outside off, blocked.
From deep inside the crease, Stanikzai nudges it to square leg and crosses over.
Shenwari goes back and tucks in front of square on the leg side for a run.
Full and straight on the stumps, it's wristed straight to short mid-wicket.
Goes leg side again, towards square leg this time. Another single to the total.
Plays with the turn and works it through mid-wicket for a run.

Short of a good length on off, catch the Afghan skipper on the pads as he comes a long way down the crease to go across the line. No chance that would be given out, the appeal is a bit pointless. Good over nonetheless. Just the 1 run off it.
Good length delivery in the off stump channel, Stanikzai plays and misses.
Quick single. A gentle tap in front of mid off and both batsmen scamper through.
Three dots in a row. Back of a length ball is knocked back past the bowler to mid on.
An extension of the arms as he pushes the fullish delivery to the cover area.
Straighter in line and fuller in length, Shenwari flicks it to mid-wicket.
Barry McCarthy back on.
Excellent over comes to an end. Dot ball as Stanikzai works it in front of square leg.
Loopy off spinner around off, Stanikzai gets a leading edge down towards short third man. Closed the face a bit early there.
Quicker through the air around off, Shenwari looks to cut but gets a bottom edge past the stumps. So close. It goes past the keeper and a single is taken.
Asghar Stanikzai will bat next.

OUT! Mohammad Nabi departs! This is a big wicket for Ireland. They're still in this game, for sure. Nabi comes down the track and lofts it high across the line over mid-wicket. McBrine in the deep settles himself under the ball and takes a good, safe catch. Brilliant stuff. 65 needed off 75 now.
Full on the stumps, Nabi pushes hard at it and mistimes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up delivery on the middle and leg stump, swept over the short fine leg region for a couple.
Simi Singh comes back on.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Short of a good length on off, Nabi rises and taps it down on the off side.
Pushes this to mid off and runs to the other end. Beats the throw at the bowler's end and gets inside the crease. Good running.
Outside off, looks to dab it to point but gets it off the bottom edge back down the track.
Big shout from Tim, not a bad one by any stretch. Cutting back in on middle, strikes Shenwari high on the thigh pads and the appeal goes up. Height saves the batsman.
Length ball coming in, takes the inside edge of Shenwari's inside edge and rolls past the leg stump.
Tim Murtagh returns to the attack.
Drinks break.
Flicked with the wrists to mid-wicket. Just the single.
Full on middle, chips it past his partner down to long on for a single.
Goes deep inside the crease, turns it to square leg with the spin and takes a brisk single.
Looped up off spinner outside off, Samiullah drives it to mid off.
Should be two and they do get it. Shenwari sweeps it through square leg and both batsmen set off quickly. Easily come back for the second.
Comes from wide of the crease and darts it on middle and leg, Nabi works it to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Overpitched on middle and leg, wristed past the diving short mid-wicket fielder for a single. 75 needed now off 90 balls.
Mohammad Nabi defends it from within the crease.
Just wide of McCarthy. Low full toss outside off, Nabi lofts it back and it's just out of the bowler's reach. Close one. To mid off but no run taken surprisingly.
Outside off, played to point.
Nicely done. Nabi gets forward to the full ball and neatly lifts it over mid off for a double.
Good length delivery attacking the stumps, it's blocked just wide of the bowler.
Loud shout, not sure for what though. It went off the forearm. Pitched up around off, Shenwari kneels down to reverse sweep but is hit on the arm.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Straighter one on off, Samiullah pushes it back to the bowler.
Turning in, on middle and leg, Nabi kneels forward and across as he sweeps it down towards short fine leg. Single stolen.
Looped up closed to off, blocked.
Spinning in from around off, Nabi from the back foot looks to flick but the ball takes the inside edge and goes off the pads through the vacant slip area.
Andy McBrine is back on to bowl.
Muted appeal denied. Full and angling down leg, Shenwari looks to flick but misses and the noise is off the ball brushing the pads.
Leans ahead and pushes the fuller ball to the cover area.
Opens the face of the bat and stabs it to the point fielder.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Back of a length outside off, some room there for Shenwari, but he can't connect and gets beaten.
A lot of bottom hand on this one as Mohammad Nabi flicks this full ball aerially through square leg. Picks up a single.
Good running. Spinning into Shenwari, he gets low and sweeps it past backward square leg for a couple.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Awesome from Shenwari! He premeditates the reverse sweep, gets low and clears short third man with ease. Gets a boundary to his name.
Attacking the stumps, on a fuller length, blocked.
Works it off the pads through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, straighter in line, dabbed to point.
FOUR! Good shot! Full and wide outside off, Shenwari drives it square past the diving backward point fielder and finds the boundary line. Much-needed, this. It's been a quiet period for the Afghans.
Some width offered outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Quite full, outside off, driven solidly to mid off.
Moves across to get behind the line of the length ball and blocks.
Length ball skidding off the deck a bit, pushed to the covers for nothing.
Wide! Going down leg, Nabi looks to flick but misses. Wide called by the umpire.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Barry McCarthy into the attack again.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Dabs this away to point. Another dot ball.
Gets close to the pitch with a big stride to work it in front of square leg.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out.
Turns it with the spin to square leg for nought.
Full and attacking the stumps, Shenwari is forward in defense.
Mohammad Nabi is the new man in.

OUT! Gulbadin Naib is out of here! Misses out on his fifty too. His long stay comes to an end. Short ball which is climbing up too fast, gets too big for Naib who top edges his pull. It balloons towards backward point where Andy Balbirnie takes a simple catch.
Edged... but it falls short! Shortish in length outside off, Gulbadin hangs his bat to block but it takes the edge and goes to the slip fielder on the bounce.
Short of a good length close to off, pushed back to the bowler from within the crease.
Plants his front foot forward and meets it with the full face.
Drives the fuller ball to long on and takes one.
Shaping away from outside off, Naib edges it down to third man for a run.
Appeal for a caught behind which goes in vain. Short and wide outside off, seeing the width Shenwari looks to cut. Niall O'Brien appeals the moment he catches the ball but the umpire remains unmoved.
Samiullah Shenwari has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
Straighter one outside off, Shenwari fails to put bat on ball.
Shorter in length and on a flatter trajectory, Shenwari off his back foot pushes this away.
Naib waits for the ball to turn before wristing it to mid-wicket for a single.
Simi Singh brought back on.
Outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Oh! That was close. On a length, on off, Gulbadin looks to defend but the slight inward movement takes the inside edge and the ball goes past the leg pole.
Edged and away! Just wide of the slip fielder. Back of a length outside off, Naib edges this through the right of the diving fielder, down to third man for a single.
Zips off the deck again, Rankin extracts extra bounce once more. It takes the leading edge of Naib's bat this time and goes safely to cover.
Connects with the punch this time, but finds the man at cover.
Length delivery outside off with some extra bounce, Naib looks to play but is beaten because of it.
Quicker through the air on off, kept out from within the crease.
Straighter one outside off, full in length, Shenwari blocks with the full face of the bat.
Samiullah Shenwari is the next batsman in.

OUT! Ireland have their second of the game! Tossed up and spinning in on middle and leg, Shah flicks it uppishly straight to short mid-wicket where Wilson takes a sharp catch. Credit to Porterfield for that, he's had that man there almost the entire game. Good captaincy. Afghanistan need 97 more to win.
Full outside off, slapped hard to extra cover.
Sliding in from around off, Shah gets behind the line and defends.
Drifting in from over the wicket, worked through mid-wicket for one.
Simi Singh back into the bowling attack.
Pushes this full ball just wide of mid off and gets to the other end with ease.
Too full in length, straighter in line as well, allows Naib to work it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Short of a good length outside off, guided comfortably to third man for one.
Full delivery on off, swinging away, Shah plays it back down the track.
Waits for the length ball to come to him and runs it down to third man for a single.
Good pace on it. Beats the batsman because of it. Back of a length on off, Naib looks to work it across the line but is beaten past the inner edge.
Boyd Rankin is back on. He has a slip in place.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. 103 runs needed for Afghanistan to win.
Knocks it down to long on and crosses over.
Plays with the spin and turns it through the mid-wicket area for a run.
Straighter one around off, Rahmat stands firm and defends.
FOUR! Gives the charge and bangs this one! Straight back over the bowler's head, Shah smashes it hard across the long on boundary. Super shot.
Turning in from outside off, Rahmat Shah prods forward and blocks it in front of covers.
Rock solid in defense as Naib pushes it back down the track. Good over from Murtagh, just the single off it.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, blocked right under his nose.
Goes a bit squarer this time. Plants his front foot forward and drives it through cover-point for a single.
Silly mid on in place.
Takes a big lunge forward to this full ball and drives it to the covers.
Stays back and defends it with a straight blade.
Full and straight, slower through the air, driven back down to the bowler.
Tossed up delivery, driven back at the bowler.
Defended off the front foot towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off stump, Naib cuts it hard past the point region for a boundary. 100 up for Afghanistan.
Tossed up delivery on the legs of the batsman, played to mid-wicket.
Floated ball around the off stump line, driven back.
Tossed up delivery, played back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery punched off the back foot to covers.
Good length delivery, angling in towards the batsman. Played to square leg for a run.
Full length delivery, driven down the ground. The fielder at mid on makes a good diving save but cannot stop the batsmen from taking a single.
Full delivery outside the off stump line, defended back to the bowler.
Length delivery driven down the ground for a single.
Back of a length delivery, defended off the back foot.
Murtagh comes back into the attack.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Easy runs these for Afghanistan. Ireland need to do more, something different here. Another easy single taken by knocking to long on.
Driven through mid-on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full and on the stumps, driven through mid on for a single.
Slower through the air and outside off, on a fuller length, Naib meets it with a straight bat in defense.
Flighted delivery outside the line of off stump, blocked out off the front foot.
Eases this full ball down to long on for a single.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
Punched off the back foot but no run taken.
With the turn again, off the front foot towards mid-wicket.
Drags the length back on this occasion, punched from the back foot to mid-wicket.
Loopy delivery full in length, outside off, Shah drives it sweetly through the covers but the slow outfield prevents the ball from reaching the fence. Three runs are taken.
Tucked to square leg again. Straight to the fielder.
Worked off the pads, towards square leg. Won't get any run for it.
Off spinner around off, punched back to the bowler off the back foot.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Straighter in line, nudged to square leg. No run taken.
Turning in on middle and leg, Naib moves inside the line and taps it in front of square leg.
Dot ball to end the over. Rahmat Shah plays it to the same fielder, in the same position.
Turning in on middle and leg, wristed away, but can't get it past short mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle and leg, driven softly to short mid-wicket.
Rahmat Shah is the next man in.

OUT! One hit too many and Mohammad Shahzad is out of here. Sees the ball landed full, in his arc, so the big man gets low and looks to clear the long on boundary. Doesn't get the distance on it and it's straight down the throat of Boyd Rankin positioned just inside the rope. A brisk knock comes to an end.
FOUR! Sublime hitting of the ball from Shahzad. Tossed up delivery on middle, spins in, he kneels down and sweeps it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Fifty for Mohammad Shahzad! His 11th in this format. He gets low to this one and slices the cut over backward point for a double.
Works it away on the leg side for a single. Afghanistan are cruising along here. Just 130 needed to win.
Use of the feet once again, this time he can only manage a block.
The replacement ball is here. Shahzad sent that one out of the park so the umpire called for a new one.

SIX! That is a towering blow from Mohammad Shahzad! Once again comes down the track, gets close to the pitch of the ball and before the ball can turn, he smokes it high and handsome right back over the bowler's head. On the roof and that's gone out of here.
Short and wide, cut hard straight to point.

FOUR! Gives the charge and gets the desired result! Dances down to get close to the pitch and lofts it high over mid on. The man in the deep runs to his right to try and stop it, but can't. Shahzad powering forward here.
Flatter, shorter and on middle, Shahzad exposes his stumps and slaps it to McBrine.
Comes half-forward, stands tall and defends the turning ball right under his nose.
Positions himself behind the line and blocks.
Spins in sharply, on middle and leg, Naib is caught on the pads as he attempts to work it away on the leg side.
Straighter one on middle and off, Gulbadin hops back and defends it down onto the track.
Goes deep inside the crease, waits for the ball to turn before punching to mid-wicket.
Tossed right up there, on off, played back to the bowler from the front foot.
Simi Singh to bowl now.
Uses the feet and comes down the track, blocks it out easily.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Plays for the turn when there is none. Shahzad pops a leading edge in front of covers as he closes the bat face a little too early.
Goes straight, down the ground towards long on and Naib earns a single.
Plays with the spin and turns it to the leg side.
Turning in on a full length, on middle and leg, Naib wrists this in front of square leg.
Solid cricket so far. Firmly punches it through to sweeper cover and gets a single for it.
Quite full and straight on the stumps, played back to the bowler for no run.
Another couple as Naib flicks this full ball on his pads through the mid-wicket area. In the gap, smartly placed.
Better placement this time. The execution is to his liking as he slaps it over backward point. Two more to the total.
In the air but in the gap too! Short and wide, Naib steers it aerially past the diving point fielder. Two runs taken as third man mops it up.
Good length delivery in the off stump channel, Naib offers no shot in response.
Stays back and keeps it out off the back foot. Using the depth of the crease there, Shahzad.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
A solid punch, from the back foot. Dot ball.

Good effort from the skipper. Shahzad slaps this through cover-point. Seems the ball is destined for the boundary but Porterfield chases after it and keeps it with a dive just before the rope. Two runs taken.
Stays leg side once more, mistimes it back to the bowler.
Spinning in from outside off, Shahzad backs away and punches it to the cover fielder.
Andy McBrine into the attack now.
Doesn't move his feet much, hangs his bat out and guards it out safely.
Fullish in length and outside off, comes forward with a straight bat in defense.
Gulbadin Naib has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Comfortably guided down to third man for one run.

FOUR! Edged and away! Good length delivery outside off, Shahzad is undone by the late away movement as the ball takes the edge on his attempted block. It's a thick one, as it flies past the diving slip fielder for a boundary.
On a good length and outside off, it's run down to third man for a single.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. 4 fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
FOUR! This one is for the cameras! Holding that pose while he hits it. Full on the stumps, Shahzad drives it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Camps on his back foot and blocks it out.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.

Not out! Sprays it on the pads, Naib flicks it behind square leg and both batsmen are running fast. They come back for the third as the throw comes in at the striker's end. The bails are off, Shahzad is a sloppy in planting his bat. So, Ireland decide to take it upstairs. Replays show he's fine.
A run out appeal against Shahzad is taken upstairs. Looks to be safe though.
Well placed through the gap. Naib leans ahead and flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.

Leading edge falls safely! Seaming away from a length outside off, Shahzad hangs his bat to it and gets it off the edge. It flies but falls well short of the fielder. Credit to Boyd Rankin here though, he does well to move to his right, dive and stop it from going past him. Single taken.
Nice carry. Well left by the batsman. It's on a length on the fourth stump line, Gulbadin withdraws his bat and lets it be.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Darted well outside off, quite harmless, so Naib has nothing to do with it.
FOUR! Nicely done. Gulbadin Naib is a neat little player. He gets it on the body, so he pulls it through square leg and finds the fence.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered by the batsman.
Short outside off, cut away square to point.
FOUR! Finds the gap perfectly this time! Short and wide outside off, Shahzad makes room and cracks it square through point for a boundary.
On the pads, easy enough for Naib to flick it down to fine leg. One run taken.

Length delivery outside the line of off stump, Shahzad backs away and slaps this to cover. Had the fielder not dived there and saved that, this would have been a boundary. Good effort, just a single taken.
Fraction straight in line once more, Shahzad moves a step across before nudging it to the man at mid-wicket.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket. No run taken.
Plays this with soft hands. Pushes it in front of mid on and calls his partner through for the run.
Connects well this tine. Plays it through mid-wicket for two runs.
Short but it's not short enough for Shahzad to pull this away. He mistimes this back to the bowler who collects it with ease.
Touch short and outside off, Shahzad looks to put bat on ball but misses.
Hangs back and blocks it with a straight bat.
Outside off on a good length, left alone by Shahzad.
Wide! False start for Rankin. He slips this down the leg side and the umpire raises his hands sideways.
Boyd Rankin comes into the bowling attack.
Dot ball to end the over. Worked towards mid-wicket, straight to fielder.
Just ahead of a length, worked to mid-wicket.
Cutting back in on middle and leg, it's played off the inner half in front of square leg for a double.
Length delivery on off stump, blocked.
Full delivery just outisde off, driven to mid on. Naib rushes to the other end and just about beats the direct hit at the bowler's end. Good running.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length delivery on the stumps, Naib works this wide of mid on and crosses over.
Too full in length and outside off, defended carefully from the front foot.
Wide! Down the leg side, Naib still goes after it but misses.
Full in length and outside off, driven to mid off.
Shaping away from a length around off, Naib closes the face a bit early and gets a leading edge on the off side.
Short of a good length close to off, kept out off the back foot.
FOUR! High full toss angling in on the pads, Naib picks it off and flicks it through short fine leg for a boundary.
Outside off on a length, dabbed to the covers to end the over.
Good firm push from Naib. Finally gets off the mark as he places it towards mid on for a single.
Presents the full face of the bat as he defends it in front of covers from the crease.
Good length ball aiming the top of off stump, Naib takes a step forward and meets it with a straight blade.
Wide! Angles it down the leg side, wide signalled by the umpire.
Stays right behind the line and blocks it out.
Length delivery shaping away from outside off, Naib pushes it away from his body on the off side.
Another slower one but this time wide outside off stump. Shahzad gets his bat to it and the ball goes aerially towards covers. The batsmen take a couple of runs. 12 runs came off the over.
FOUR! Followed it up with a good shot. He picked the slower one with ease and lofted it between mid-wicket and long-on for a boundary.
SIX! Bad ball and he will put you away! Full and down the leg side, Shahzad flicks it towards fine leg over the rope for a maximum.

DROPPED! But that was struck with some power. Catches like these need to stick. Length delivery around the off stump line, Shahzad hits it back to the bowler. He gets his hand to it but cannot pouch it. The ball rolls to the mid off region.
Slower delivery played to mid on.
Short and wide outside the off stump line, punched to covers. The fielder does well to make a diving save.
Back of a length ball, defended off the back foot. 3 runs came off the over.
Full length ball around the off stump line, defended off the front foot.
Back of a length delivery around the middle and leg stump, tucked to fine leg for a run.
Length ball around the off stump line, played off the front foot.
Back of a length delivery, defended to mid on.
Length ball outside the off stump line, Shahzad slogs it to square leg. Two runs taken.
Tim Murtagh will bowl from other end.
Length delivery outside off stump, left alone.
Full length delivery outside off stump, played to mid off.

Back of a length delivery, drifting down the leg side. Shahzad tries to clip it off his hips but fails to make any connection. The ball hits his thigh pad and rolls to the leg side. The sneak in a leg bye.
Back of a length delivery around the off stump line, defended off the back foot.
Wide! McCarthy drifts it down the leg side, the umpire signals it a wide.
First runs for Afghanistan. Full delivery drifting down the leg side, played to square leg for a brace.
Short delivery banged in towards the batsman, defended off the back foot.
The umpires are out in the middle. Mohammad Shahzad and Gulbadin Naib will open the innings for Afghanistan. Barry McCarthy will have the new ball in hand. Let's begin the run chase.
